source_intents.action_description: Add a product below the MOQ for the location and attempt to submit an order; repeat with quantity at or above MOQ; test with CSJ MOQ = 1; test with a 10lbs cylinder; test with no CSJ MOQ set
source_intents.expected_behavior: Order submission is blocked with a validation message when quantity is below MOQ; order proceeds when quantity meets or exceeds MOQ; CSJ MOQ = 1 allows single-unit orders; 10lbs cylinder enforces MOQ correctly; system defaults to MOQ = 2 when no CSJ value is configured for the location
preconditions: At least one product is in the cart
CSJ minimum order quantity is configured for the location (C number) or defaults to 2
test_data_hints: Location (C number) with CSJ MOQ value configured
Small CO2 or nitrogen cylinder product
Location with no CSJ MOQ set (expected default: 2)
Location with CSJ MOQ explicitly set to 1
source_intents.original_text: CF-09 | MOQ | Smoke | To verify that the system enforces the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) during checkout based on the rules set by the CSJ for the location (C number) | System is upgraded to Magento 2.4.6-p9. User is logged in. At least one product is in the cart. CSJ minimum order quantity value is configured for the location or defaults to 2 if not set | Log in; add product with quantity less than MOQ; proceed to checkout; click Submit Order; observe message; repeat with quantity >= MOQ; repeat with CSJ MOQ = 1; repeat with 10lbs cylinder; repeat with no MOQ value set.

source_observations.summary: Add CO2 cylinder to cart — qty=1, below configured MOQ of 2
Place order with qty=1 (below MOQ=2) — order ACCEPTED, MOQ check did not fire

reconciliation.reasoning: OBS-008 shows an order with qty=1 placed successfully (HTTP 200) against a location where moq_configured=2. The response explicitly records moq_enforced=false and moq_rejection_reason=null. The intent correctly specifies that orders below MOQ must be blocked with a validation message — the MOQ enforcement logic has stopped firing, which is a clear regression.
reconciliation.final_expected_behavior: REGRESSION DETECTED: Order submission MUST be blocked when quantity is below the configured MOQ. The observed system accepted qty=1 (HTTP 200) against moq_configured=2 with moq_enforced=false. The generated test must assert that POST /rest/V1/carts/mine/payment-information with qty < MOQ returns HTTP 4xx and a validation message identifying the MOQ requirement.

classification.reasoning: MOQ enforcement is implemented in the checkout REST API pipeline. API-level tests can directly probe the rejection behavior by submitting orders with varying quantities and asserting HTTP status codes.

alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: MOQ enforcement fires inside the Magento checkout pipeline — unit testing requires mocking quote, cart, and CSJ repositories which obscures the actual regression path.
MOQ validation is a REST API concern; E2E via browser cannot easily assert on raw HTTP status codes or inspect the exact rejection message.

alternatives_rejected.draft_summary: First draft asserted assertSame(200) for below-MOQ order, treating the regression as expected behaviour.
alternatives_rejected.reason_rejected: Reconciliation is behavior_regressed — test must assert HTTP 4xx for below-MOQ, not 200. Draft inverted the signal.

dimensions.name: syntactic_validity
dimensions.notes: Valid PHP. clearCart() helper is clean. All assertions use correct PHPUnit methods.

dimensions.name: behavior_fidelity
dimensions.notes: Excellent regression coverage: tests qty<MOQ (rejection), qty=MOQ (acceptance), and CSJ MOQ=1 (single-unit allowed). All three paths from the reconciliation's final_expected_behavior are exercised. Minor gap: does not test the default MOQ=2 scenario where no CSJ value is set (relies on CO2-CYLINDER-20LB having moq_configured=2 implicitly).

dimensions.name: coverage_delta
dimensions.notes: Adds boundary-value coverage (qty=MOQ, qty<MOQ) and a CSJ override path. Three distinct test methods means CI failures are attributable to a specific MOQ scenario.

dimensions.name: assertion_quality
dimensions.notes: assertGreaterThanOrEqual(400) + assertLessThan(500) is precise for HTTP range. assertNotEmpty($body['message']) is good but could be strengthened with assertStringContainsString to verify the message mentions MOQ or minimum quantity. testOrderAtMoqThresholdIsAccepted correctly asserts assertIsInt + assertGreaterThan(0).

dimensions.name: determinism
dimensions.notes: clearCart() in each test prevents cart state leakage. No random values. N2-MOQ1-CYLINDER SKU dependency should be documented in test fixtures README so environment setup is reproducible.

steering_signals_applied.rule_text: Prefer assertSame over assertEquals for HTTP status code assertions (strict type safety).
Use assertStringContainsString for error message assertions, never assertContains on strings.
